title: Kimi K3 launches as largest free, open-source AI beating Claude #KimiK3 #MoonshotAI #OpenAI
description: Moonshot AI launched Kimi K3, the largest open-source AI model with 2.8 trillion parameters, offering free access to users worldwide. Kimi K3 outperforms competitors like Claude and GPT models in various tests, including game development, motion graphics, and realistic physics simulations, while maintaining significantly lower operating costs. The model enables innovative applications such as an interactive 3D open world accessible via browsers, advanced game coding, and dynamic environmental effects that enhance realism. Its open-source nature empowers developers to build and customize AI-driven projects without prohibitive expenses, marking a major shift in the AI landscape dominated by expensive proprietary models. Kimi K3’s competitive performance and affordability challenge Silicon Valley’s AI dominance, highlighting China’s rapidly growing influence and capability in cutting-edge AI technology development. This advancement promises broader democratization of AI tools and accelerated innovation across industries. #KimiK3 #MoonshotAI #OpenSourceAI #AIModels #ChineseAI #ArtificialIntelligence #ClaudeAI #GPTCompetitors #AIInnovation #3DOpenWorld #AIGaming #MotionGraphicsAI #AIPhysics #SiliconValleyAI #TechInnovation
